purpose: Same functional fields for every country; labels in their own column. Look for physical oscillations (energy, resources) under the labels, and what they end up deciding. Labels are data, never a field value.

rules.same_basis: same field, same source type, same caveat scale for every country. A field is filled for a country only from the source declared for that field; a source that covers some countries and not others leaves the uncovered ones VOID.
rules.void: unmeasured -> VOID + reason. A VOID is never read as zero, as 'no', or as a match.
rules.no_recall: no value is typed from model memory. A value enters only from bytes fetched in a run, with URL or repository commit, and sha256.
rules.no_index: no index score is invented here. A published index may be recorded as its publisher's number under dissent_cost, named as theirs.
rules.labels: self-labels and labels-by-others live in table/labels.json only. They are never joined into table/functional.json and never used as a field value or a grouping key.
rules.no_verdicts: no verdict on any regime; no ranking of countries; events carry no causal tag.

test.question: do resource-stress changes lead policy / conflict events beyond a shuffled-date null?
test.stress_change: per country and year t: the largest year-on-year rise in net import balance across oil, gas and coal, max_f(balance_f[t] - balance_f[t-1]). Balance is used, not the unbounded share, so one exporter year cannot dominate.
test.statistic: mean stress_change over the lead window (years e-3 .. e-1) across a country's events
test.null: event years redrawn uniformly without replacement from the same country's series years that have a full lead window; 1000 draws; seed 20261124
test.report: per country: observed statistic, null mean, null 5th and 95th percentile, share of null draws >= observed, n events. No pooled verdict.
test.refusals: a country with fewer than 3 dated events -> NOT RUN (too few events). No events file -> NOT RUN.
test.constants: 3-year window, 1000 draws, minimum 3 events: chosen, no external source

amendments.title: lead-test calibration + source origin

calibration.what: false-flag rate (alpha) of the lead test on pure noise
calibration.design: 200 seeds (0..199). Per seed: stress = independent Gaussian noise, sd 0.01, years 1960..2024; 8 event years drawn without replacement from 1970..2023; lead test as declared (3-year window, 1000 draws). A seed flags when share_null_ge_observed <= 0.05.
calibration.report: alpha = flagged seeds / 200, with the count
calibration.rule: if alpha > 0.05: report it and propose a fix as a separate declared amendment. Do not apply the fix.

amendments.title: lead-test false-flag rate
amendments.why: amendment A1's calibration returned alpha above the nominal 0.05 (see series/calibration.json). At 200 seeds the 95% interval still includes 0.05, so 200 seeds cannot say whether the test over-flags or the excess is seed noise.
proposal: step 1: rerun the same calibration at 2000 seeds, design otherwise unchanged

step 2, only if the 2000-seed 95% interval excludes 0.05: lower the flag threshold on share_null_ge_observed from 0.05 to the largest value whose calibrated alpha is at most 0.05, and record the new threshold with its calibration
step 3: until A2 is decided, any real flag from the lead test is reported together with the A1 alpha
amendments.not_done: none of these steps has been run or applied
